scope: Second render-only development specimen. V1 failed: the displaced whole face lengthened the apparent early slit by ~0.5 mm and the guarded nominal second closure refused at actual 3 mm; the noisy trial jumped directly from 6 to 9 mm. This version changes only which vertices of the same surviving adjacent face recede.
render_rule: Leave all outboard vertices of surviving faces at their physical PBD node positions, including longitudinal outer borders. Only vertices at the two central seam columns (11/12) on an existing face bordering a missing face recede transversely 0.4 mm toward their bank. Keep v1's whole-face render mode unchanged for its historical images. Spring/tissue nodes, face survival, actual grip sweep, structural score and all guards are unchanged.
screen: From zero two strict-vision FSMs, with unchanged closure budgets, optical reader and seeds. Seal RGB-D-only predictions before joining independent structural labels. Require two supported BELOW at true 8 mm under 0.5 mm noise and two supported STOP at true 9 mm nominal, no false STOP below 9, no tear/fault or trace over 10 mm. If either actual 8/9 state is absent, fail the pair rather than infer from bite count. No integration or five-case run until this screen passes.
